g.text: ISOLAMENTO BIDIREZIONALE J3 <-> J1/J140 — /OE=1 APERTO, /OE=0 COLLEGATO

g.desc: ISOLAMENTO BIDIREZIONALE J3 <-> J1/J140 — /OE=1 APERTO, /OE=0 COLLEGATO

g.text: A0-A5 = lato micro/J3; PORT_A0-A5 = lato MOSFET e J1/J140. Default aperto.

g.desc: A0-A5 = lato micro/J3; PORT_A0-A5 = lato MOSFET e J1/J140. Default aperto.

g.text: Shared 3.3 V: ESP32-S3, LEDs, peripherals and camera LDO inputs.

g.desc: Shared 3.3 V: ESP32-S3, LEDs, peripherals and camera LDO inputs.

g.text: VCORE: 5 V TO 3.3 V / 2 A BUCK

g.desc: VCORE: 5 V TO 3.3 V / 2 A BUCK

g.text: 33k / 10k: nominal 3.302 V. Total load and thermal check required.

g.desc: 33k / 10k: nominal 3.302 V. Total load and thermal check required.

g.text: GPIO3: RESET, open-drain only; JTAG strap.

g.desc: GPIO3: RESET, open-drain only; JTAG strap.

g.text: Fit only for a verified peripheral. R31-R35: DNP in camera profile.

g.desc: Fit only for a verified peripheral. R31-R35: DNP in camera profile.

g.text: UART0 shared with debug; TX may emit boot logs.

g.desc: UART0 shared with debug; TX may emit boot logs.

g.text: Keep VIN bypass, bootstrap and SW loop short.

g.desc: Keep VIN bypass, bootstrap and SW loop short.

g.text: GPIO mode: /OE=0, P=OFF, N=OFF. 3V3/GND mode: /OE=1 prima di abilitare il MOSFET.

g.desc: GPIO mode: /OE=0, P=OFF, N=OFF. 3V3/GND mode: /OE=1 prima di abilitare il MOSFET.

g.text: Check peripheral pinout, voltages and flex orientation.

g.desc: Check peripheral pinout, voltages and flex orientation.

g.text: GPIO46: standby; boot strap, keep low at reset.

g.desc: GPIO46: standby; boot strap, keep low at reset.

g.text: R35: only if peripheral accepts 3.3 V control.

g.desc: R35: only if peripheral accepts 3.3 V control.

g.text: U11: indirizzo I2C 0x20. Tutti i gate spenti al reset tramite pull-up P / pull-down N.

g.desc: U11: indirizzo I2C 0x20. Tutti i gate spenti al reset tramite pull-up P / pull-down N.

g.text: NON attivare P e N insieme. Questa revisione non aggiunge limitazione hardware.

g.desc: NON attivare P e N insieme. Questa revisione non aggiunge limitazione hardware.

g.text: IMPLEMENTATO: solo GPIO/3V3/GND. INA, shunt, DAC e lettura ADC dedicata rimandati.

g.desc: IMPLEMENTATO: solo GPIO/3V3/GND. INA, shunt, DAC e lettura ADC dedicata rimandati.

g.text: FPC shares I2C on GPIO4/5; pull-ups to 3.3 V.

g.desc: FPC shares I2C on GPIO4/5; pull-ups to 3.3 V.

g.text: VCORE also supplies LEDs: check total load and temperature.

g.desc: VCORE also supplies LEDs: check total load and temperature.

g.text: Input: VCORE 3.3 V. Place capacitors close to the LDO.

g.desc: Input: VCORE 3.3 V. Place capacitors close to the LDO.

g.text: Input: VCORE 3.3 V. Place capacitors close to the LDO.

g.desc: Input: VCORE 3.3 V. Place capacitors close to the LDO.

g.text: VCORE also supplies LEDs: check total load and temperature.

g.desc: VCORE also supplies LEDs: check total load and temperature.

g.text: Defaults retained; optional GPIO links via R34/R35.

g.desc: Defaults retained; optional GPIO links via R34/R35.

g.text: PORTE UNIVERSALI A0-A5 — BASE GPIO / 3V3 / GND

g.desc: PORTE UNIVERSALI A0-A5 — BASE GPIO / 3V3 / GND

g.text: Q3-Q8: A=P-channel; B=N-channel. U11 A-F: comandi, G: alimentazione/I2C.

g.desc: Q3-Q8: A=P-channel; B=N-channel. U11 A-F: comandi, G: alimentazione/I2C.

g.text: J1/J140: PORT_A0-A5. J3: lato micro diretto. GPIO13/14: comandi isolamento.

g.desc: J1/J140: PORT_A0-A5. J3: lato micro diretto. GPIO13/14: comandi isolamento.

g.text: VARIANTI: Manual / Base (XL9535) / Pro (TI + Q32 + INA). Vedere il foglio Porte Pro e la BOM.

g.desc: VARIANTI: Manual / Base (XL9535) / Pro (TI + Q32 + INA). Vedere il foglio Porte Pro e la BOM.

g.text: Firmware: prima GPIO in ingresso; spegnere entrambi i MOSFET prima di cambiare modo.

g.desc: Firmware: prima GPIO in ingresso; spegnere entrambi i MOSFET prima di cambiare modo.

g.text: Fixed auxiliary rails: 2.8 V / 1.5 V. Check peripheral voltage requirements.

g.desc: Fixed auxiliary rails: 2.8 V / 1.5 V. Check peripheral voltage requirements.

g.text: FPC signals, fixed bias pins and voltage limits: see project documentation.

g.desc: FPC signals, fixed bias pins and voltage limits: see project documentation.

g.text: OPTIONAL FPC CONNECTIONS - 0R LINKS, DNP BY DEFAULT

g.desc: OPTIONAL FPC CONNECTIONS - 0R LINKS, DNP BY DEFAULT
